questions: Are you experiencing any weakness or clumsiness in your hands?
Do you have difficulty with fine motor tasks, such as buttoning a shirt or writing?
Have you noticed any muscle wasting (shrinking) in the muscles of your hands?
Do you experience numbness or tingling in your fingers?
If yes to numbness/tingling, is it mostly in your thumb, index, and middle fingers?
Does shaking your hands relieve the symptoms?
Do you have pain radiating from your neck down into your arm?
Is the problem affecting both hands?
orders: Test finger abduction and adduction strength against resistance
Inspect the first dorsal interosseous and thenar eminence for atrophy
Perform Tinel's sign at the wrist
Assess sensation in the little finger compared to the ring finger
Order nerve conduction studies and electromyography (NCS/EMG) of the upper limbs
results: 1. Test finger abduction and adduction strength against resistance
2. Inspect the first dorsal interosseous and thenar eminence for atrophy
muscle tone examination: right-sided rigidity with dystonic posturing of the right fingers
3. Perform Tinel's sign at the wrist
5. Assess sensation in the little finger compared to the ring finger
sensory examination (pinprick, vibration, proprioception): right-sided sensory inattention and astereognosis
6. Order nerve conduction studies and electromyography (NCS/EMG) of the upper limbs
